question: How many open claims does each Southeast adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract) currently assigned to each adjuster whose region is Southeast. This covers all report dates. Adjusters with no open claims are included.
report.answer: Four Southeast adjusters hold all 206 open Southeast claims: Michelle Hebert (ADJ-018) has 60, Pamela Rojas (ADJ-019) 54, Patricia Carr (ADJ-021) 48 and Brittney Watkins (ADJ-020) 44. Theresa Wilson (ADJ-016) and Kayla Rodriguez (ADJ-017) left in May 2026 and have no open claims, so their cases appear to have been reassigned.
report.answer_sql: SELECT a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open') AS open_claims FROM adjusters a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id WHERE a.region='Southeast' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY open_claims DESC, a.adjuster_id

findings.claim: Open claims are concentrated on four active adjusters. Michelle Hebert carries the most, and the two departed adjusters carry none. No Southeast adjuster holds an open claim outside the Southeast region.
findings.evidence_sql: SELECT a.adjuster_id, a.leave_date, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open') AS open_claims, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open' AND c.region<>'Southeast') AS open_outside_region FROM adjusters a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id WHERE a.region='Southeast' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY open_claims DESC

data_quality_issues.issue: The most recent weeks of claims are incomplete because claims are reported late. About 79% of September 2026 claims are expected to be reported by the extract date.
data_quality_issues.impact: Open counts may rise slightly as late-reported claims arrive.
